query: Review last month's Qonto transactions for tax reflexes I might have missed.
expected_behavior: Flags the foreign SaaS charges (Anthropic, Vercel, AWS) for VAT reverse-charge (autoliquidation) on the CA3
Detects a business trip and proposes mileage (frais kilométriques) for the far restaurant (Brasserie Georges = Lyon), resolved via web search
Does NOT propose mileage for the local restaurant (Bouillon Chartier = Paris, the office city)
Flags the hotel (Ibis Lyon) VAT as non-recoverable
Ends every suggestion with a note to confirm with the accountant; never asserts a figure not present in references/rules-fr-is-tns.md

query: What tax reflexes did I miss in June?
expected_behavior: For the cryptic label 'LE COMPTOIR DU MARCHE', when web search does not resolve a city and a receipt is attached, calls Qonto:get_attachment and reads the merchant address off the receipt
Resolves the city to Reims from the receipt and proposes mileage that web search alone could not find
Never fabricates a distance; asks to confirm the route and the vehicle's fiscal power (CV)

query: Which tax breaks (niches) could I activate?
expected_behavior: Surfaces standalone niches applicable to a solo SARL à l'IS gérant TNS (e.g. reduced 15% IS band, JEI window, home-office redevance, PER, mécénat)
Presents CESU as eligibility uncertain because the company has no employees (does not present it as a done deal)
Never proposes the crédit d'impôt formation du dirigeant (abolished by the 2026 Finance Act — listed in the ⚠️ section)

query: I'm an auto-entrepreneur (micro regime) — review my transactions for tax reflexes.
expected_behavior: Recognizes regime_fiscal = micro and loads references/rules-fr-micro.md instead of the baseline
Does NOT propose expense deductions (mileage, meals, <500€, fuel) — explains the flat abatement already covers costs
Still flags reverse-charge VAT (autoliquidation) on the foreign services (Anthropic, Vercel, AWS) — applies EVEN under franchise en base
Surfaces micro-specific items (CA thresholds, franchise-TVA threshold, versement libératoire, ACRE, CFE relief) rather than IS/TNS niches

query: I run a SASU (I'm the president) — what tax reflexes am I missing?
expected_behavior: Recognizes regime_social = assimilé-salarié and loads references/rules-fr-is-assimile.md on top of the baseline
Keeps the company-level nudges (reverse-charge VAT, deductions) and IS niches (15% band, JEI)
Does NOT propose Madelin or the 26% TNS abatement (TNS-only)
On dividends, applies the 40% allowance and does NOT mention the 10% capital threshold (a SARL-TNS rule)

query: I'm an EI at the régime réel (à l'IR) — review my transactions for tax reflexes.
expected_behavior: Recognizes regime_fiscal = IR-réel and loads references/rules-fr-ir-reel.md on top of the baseline
Keeps the expense and VAT nudges (mileage, meals, reverse-charge VAT) and TNS niches (26% abatement, Madelin)
Does NOT propose the IS 15% band or dividend rules (no IS at the IR)
Does not treat the owner's own draw as a deductible charge
